row: North Shore Horse Rescue and Sanctuary

We are North Shore Horse Rescue and Sanctuary, a small horse farm on the east end of Long Island, New York.  We are a 501(c)3 organization that is also verified by the Global Federation of Animal Sanctuaries and a Guardian for Equus Foundation.  Our mission is to rescue and care for any unwanted horses including those that have been neglected, abused, abandoned or are at risk of going to slaughter.  If the horse can be rehabilitated and adopted, we will find a loving, informed home for them.  If suitable homes cannot be found, North Shore Horse Rescue has committed itself to allowing its’ permanent residents to live out their lives in a safe, stress-free environment.

We are highlighting videos of our work with horses.  We will show you how we care for our rescue horses.  The stories of the rescues will be highlighted.  Our goal is to further our mission by explaining the hardships these magnificent creatures endure  and how they lead a happy life in our care.
